main.summary: Represents the structured terminal outcome produced by a command core execution.
main.remarks: The result transports output and diagnostic state through the command execution template. distinguishes a requested null output from the absence of output.

property.name: Exception
property.summary: Gets the exception transported to the terminal Activity record, if any.

property.name: HasOutput
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether publication of is requested, including when the payload is null.
property.remarks: This property expresses publication intent. After result application, reports whether publication actually succeeded.

property.name: Message
property.summary: Gets the optional terminal diagnostic message.

method.name: Canceled
method.summary: Creates a canceled result without output.

method.name: CanceledWithOutput
method.summary: Creates a canceled result with an output to publish.
method.param: The output payload. A null value is published.
method.returns: A canceled command result with output.

method.name: Failed
method.summary: Creates an expected failure result without output.

method.name: FailedWithOutput
method.summary: Creates an expected failure result with an output to publish.
method.param: The output payload. A null value is published.
method.returns: A failed command result with output.

method.name: Faulted
method.summary: Creates a faulted result without output.
method.param: An optional diagnostic message. The exception message is used when omitted.

method.name: FaultedWithOutput
method.summary: Creates a faulted result with an output to publish.
method.param: The output payload. A null value is published.
An optional diagnostic message. The exception message is used when omitted.
method.returns: A faulted command result with output.

method.name: Success
method.summary: Creates a successful result without output.

method.name: SuccessWithOutput
method.summary: Creates a successful result with an output to publish.
method.param: The output payload. A null value is published.
method.returns: A successful command result with output.

method.name: TimedOut
method.summary: Creates a timed-out result without output.

method.name: TimedOutWithOutput
method.summary: Creates a timed-out result with an output to publish.
method.param: The output payload. A null value is published.
method.returns: A timed-out command result with output.
